title: Household Add-On Membership: dependent age thresholds and age-out basis
content:
## Scope
This document states, for each Household Add-On Membership tier, the minimum age at which a dependent may be signed up, whether guardian consent is required below that minimum, the maximum dependent age (if any) after which the tier converts to closed, the notice given before that conversion, what the tier's dependent converts to at age-out, and the minimum age required to qualify as a senior parent dependent.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Minimum signup age | Guardian consent required under minimum | Maximum dependent age (a value of 0 means no limit) | Age-out notice | Age-out conversion target | Senior-parent minimum age |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Spouse Add-On | 18 years | not required | 0, no limit | not applicable | none | not applicable |
| Domestic Partner Add-On | 18 years | not required | 0, no limit | not applicable | none | not applicable |
| Dependent Child Add-On | 0 years | required | 18 years | 30 calendar days | Young Adult Add-On | not applicable |
| Young Adult Add-On | 18 years | not required | 26 years | 30 calendar days | none | not applicable |
| Senior Parent Add-On | 65 years | not required | 0, no limit | not applicable | none | 65 years |
| Household Multi-Add-On | 0 years | required | 0, no limit | not applicable | none | not applicable |

## Points of judgement
- Only the Dependent Child Add-On and the Young Adult Add-On carry a maximum dependent age above zero; every other tier's maximum dependent age of zero means that tier has no age ceiling at all, so no notice or conversion basis applies to it.
- The Dependent Child Add-On is the only tier whose age-out conversion target is another add-on tier (the Young Adult Add-On) rather than none; a Young Adult Add-On that later ages out converts to no further add-on tier.
- The Senior Parent Add-On's minimum signup age of 65 years is also its senior-parent minimum age; the two figures coincide for this tier because only a dependent who already meets the senior-parent minimum may be signed up under it in the first place.
- Guardian consent is required only under the Dependent Child Add-On and the Household Multi-Add-On, each of which sets a minimum signup age of zero years; every other tier's minimum signup age is 18 years or higher, and none of those tiers requires guardian consent.
